All 31 tests pass. Only `bowling.py` was modified.

**Implementation** (`bowling.py`):
- `roll(pins)` — validates pins (0–10), rejects rolls after the game is complete, and rejects any roll that would put two rolls on the same set of pins over 10 (correctly handling the tenth frame, where a strike resets the pins so only the second bonus roll is constrained by the third).
- `score()` — raises if the game is incomplete, otherwise scores frames 1–9 with strike (next two rolls) and spare (next roll) bonuses, and adds the raw sum of the tenth frame.
- `_frames()` — derives up to 10 frames from the roll list (single roll per strike in frames 1–9, all remaining rolls in the tenth frame).
- `_frame_complete()` / `_game_complete()` — a frame is complete when it's a strike, has two rolls, or (tenth frame) has three rolls / an open two-roll frame; the game is complete when all ten are.
